description: Returns promptly with data.job_id and data.status=queued after persisting the request. The existing platform job worker performs the read; retrieve its completed result or error with service_interface::job_service::get_job using this exact job_id. A queue receipt does not assert that the measurement succeeded. Required since (inclusive) and until (exclusive) are ISO-8601 timestamps with a time zone, since earlier than until. Optional command_patterns is an object {name: regular expression}; optional session_ids lists transcript ids. The job reads only the transcripts under the root of the enabled claude_code_local session source, for the files touched since the window began, and writes nothing. The result is one document: window {since, until}, sessions sorted by transcript id, totals and advisories. Each session row (never keyed by a session name) has wakes {total, by_source with person, peer_report, job_completion, result_delivery, overdue_notice, rotation_notice, own_background_task, scheduled_wake and other, pane_notices, duplicate_pane_notices}, model_calls counted per API request, context_tokens {median, p90, max} per call, tokens {input, cache_read, cache_write, output, input_total}, command_counts with one count per caller pattern, tmux_capture_pane_calls and self_scheduled_wakeup_calls. Totals sum the same fields and add sessions, with context statistics over all calls. A session with no record in the window is omitted. Advisories name what could not be measured: source_not_registered, ledger_service_unavailable, transcript_root_missing, sessions_not_found:<ids>, unreadable_files:<n> and unparseable_lines:<n>; each leaves the rest of the document in place. The same measurement runs from a shell with no platform present: python -m claude_code_filesystem_session_source_plugin.session_activity --root <dir> --since <time> --until <time>.
embedding_description: Queue a read-only measurement, for a time window, of how each local Claude Code session was woken and what it ran: wakes by source, pane notices and duplicates, model calls per request, context per call, token totals, tmux capture-pane and self-scheduled wake-up calls, and tool calls matching caller patterns. Returns a job_id; read the JSON document through job_service.get_job.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch: {job_id, status: queued}. The completed job result is the activity document: window {since, until}; sessions, each {session_id, wakes {total, by_source{person, peer_report, job_completion, result_delivery, overdue_notice, rotation_notice, own_background_task, scheduled_wake, other}, pane_notices, duplicate_pane_notices}, model_calls, context_tokens {median, p90, max; null with no calls}, tokens {input, cache_read, cache_write, output, input_total}, command_counts {pattern name: count}, tmux_capture_pane_calls, self_scheduled_wakeup_calls}; totals with the same fields summed plus sessions; advisories.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: On dispatch, report the job_id and queued status. Read that exact job before presenting values; never present queued acceptance as a measurement. Quote counts exactly and name the window. Model calls are API requests, not transcript records, so one call can span several records. Duplicate pane notices are already included in wakes.total and by_source. Show every advisory beside the values: an empty sessions list with source_not_registered or transcript_root_missing means nothing was readable, not that nothing happened.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: To read one session, pass its transcript id in session_ids. To count a kind of command, pass a pattern: a shell call is matched against the text 'Bash <command>', any other tool against '<tool name> <input as compact sorted JSON>'.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: The activity measurement could not be queued or failed while reading transcripts; nothing was written.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A parameter_invalid failure means since or until is missing, malformed, without a time zone or not in order, a pattern is not a valid regular expression string, or session_ids is not a list of non-empty strings; no job was created. A failed job carries the read error; missing sources and unreadable files are advisories in a completed result instead.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the named parameter and call again. After successful dispatch, read the exact job error before another invocation. If the source is not registered, use the operator-approved session-source registration path; this process does not register or poll sources.
